observation: The native binary-mixture coefficients reduce mathematically to a quartic double-well potential. An independent implementation uses that reduced expression and periodic neighbor-difference sums, while GPU translations retain the original coefficient arithmetic. Complete four-field comparisons plus a separate periodic concentration invariant test more than native array agreement. Constant and Fourier-mode inputs supplement signed dyadic fields and partial tiles; neither short-step accuracy nor conservation establishes long-time coarsening or continuous PDE convergence.
